items.description: Replacement of stolen clothing, personal effects and everyday jewellery
items.rationale: Sections 2.6.3 and 4.2.6 require movable property to be co-insured for forcible removal, which the supplied documents do not confirm. If that cover is in force and the articles are substantiated, §§4.4.5–4.4.6 and 7.1.1(d) support an estimated €650 gross for like-for-like replacement without the high-value jewellery cap.

items.description: Emergency repair and re-securing of the forced back door
items.rationale: Section 2.6.2 covers forced-entry damage to the door and lock under the building peril, and §5.2.2 covers necessary immediate re-securing without double recovery. Allow €325 gross for temporary boarding and like-for-like lock and frame work, below the €1,000 securing cap.
